units.source_text: 左卫门督所写的，一味冠冕堂皇，锋芒毕露，然而笔法并不十分端正，有矫揉造作之感。

en.t: The pieces written by the Captain of the Left Gate Guard were grand and showy, with their brilliance laid bare, but the brushwork was not very well disciplined and had a somewhat affected air.

units.source_text: 所写的诗歌也都选用奇特之作。

en.t: The poems he copied out were also all unusual selections.

units.source_text: 妇女的作品，源氏不肯多拿出来。

en.t: As for the works by the women, Genji was unwilling to bring many of them out.

units.source_text: 尤其是前斋院槿姬所作，绝不轻易示人。

en.t: In particular, he would never lightly show anyone the works by Princess Asagao, the former Kamo priestess.

units.source_text: 诸少年所书的苇手册子，风流潇洒，各尽其美。

en.t: The reed-script booklets written by the young gentlemen were graceful and free, each displaying its own full beauty.

units.source_text: 夕雾所作的模仿水流之势，畅快活泼，处处芦苇乱生，很像产苇有名的难波浦上的景色。

en.t: Yugiri's piece imitated the movement of flowing water, lively and unrestrained, with reeds growing thickly here and there, much like the scenery of Naniwa Bay, famous for its reeds.

units.source_text: 像水的文字与像苇的文字交互错综，非常美观。

en.t: Characters shaped like water and characters shaped like reeds intertwined with one another, making a very beautiful sight.

units.source_text: 又有数页，一反优美华丽之风，将文字加以意匠，写成怪石嶙峋之状。

en.t: There were also several pages that completely departed from the elegant and gorgeous style, arranging the characters with deliberate design so that they looked like jagged strange rocks.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王看了深感兴趣，说道：“这真是见所未见。

en.t: Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, looked at them with deep interest and said, "This is truly something I have never seen before.

units.source_text: 写此种文字，要费不少工夫呢！”

en.t: Writing characters of this kind must take a great deal of effort!"

units.source_text: 原来这位亲王对万事都感兴趣，乃风雅之人，故特别赏识此种技艺。

en.t: This prince was naturally interested in everything and was a person of refined taste, so he especially appreciated this sort of artistry.
